title: logast traffic.yaml
description: Optional. Calls per day per entrypoint, from production, e.g. Prometheus: sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count[1d])). Regenerated by logast traffic <root>, filled-in values kept.

patterns.description: A rate for every entrypoint whose label matches and has no value of its own: * within a path segment, ** across segments; the most specific match wins

additionalProperties.description: Calls per day, from production; empty: no estimate (log levels and metrics stay cautious)

entrypoints.description: Entrypoint label ("POST /orders", "@Scheduled Job.run", …) → calls per day; a value here wins over a pattern and a schedule

additionalProperties.description: Calls per day, from production; empty: no estimate (log levels and metrics stay cautious)
